events.title: Trevor Steven , the 에버턴 winger, becomes the latest Englishman to sign for 레인저스 when he agrees terms for a £1.5 million transfer. 케니 샌섬 leaves 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 to return to London in an exchange deal to 퀸스 파크 레인저스, with Wayne Fereday moving in the opposite direction.

The domestic season draws to a close when 크리스털 팰리스 overhaul a 3–1 deficit to defeat 블랙번 로버스 4–3 on aggregate to win promotion to the First Division after an eight-year exile. 5 June 1989 – John Lyall , the longest-serving manager currently employed in the Football League, is sacked after 15 years in charge of relegated 웨스트햄 유나이티드. He had been with the club for 34 years, since joining them as an apprentice on leaving school in 1955 at the age of 15.
셰필드 웬즈데이 sign 20-year-old striker Dalian Atkinson from 입스위치 타운 for £450,000.
리즈 유나이티드 sign midfielder 비니 존스 from 윔블던 for £650,000.
게리 리네커 ends three years in Spain with 바르셀로나 to return to England in a £2 million move to 토트넘 홋스퍼.
In the final of the FIFA U-16 World Championship , Saudi Arabia became surprising winners during the penalty shoot-out to Scotland in Glasgow .
빌리 브렘너 is appointed manager of 동커스터 로버스 for the second time succeeding caretaker manager Joe Kinnear .
